text: だれかに　すがたを　みられると　しっぽで　あなをほって　にげだす。

structure.jp: だれかに　すがたを　みられると
structure.en: when it is seen by someone

structure.jp: しっぽで　あなをほって
structure.en: it digs a hole with its tail and

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: だれかに　すがたを　みられる
patterns.explanation: The られる ending says the action is done to it, and に shows who does it. だれかに　すがたを　みられる = 'it has its form seen by someone', that is, 'someone sees it'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says 'whenever this happens, that follows'. みられると = 'whenever it is seen'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins this action to the next one like 'and then'. あなをほって = 'digs a hole and'.
